note: These categories have no public search API (unlike grants.gov). Run the queries below inside Claude Code, which has live web search, and log each real result via search_web.add_manual_opportunity(). Re-run on a cadence (e.g. monthly) since these open/close on rolling or annual cycles.

categories.notes: IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: most CDFI products are LOANS or investments, not grants. Only log something here if it's a genuine grant, grant-plus-loan blend, or no-cost technical assistance program aimed at nonprofits/youth programs — not a straight loan product, since that's a different kind of decision (debt) than a grant application.
example_queries: Los Angeles CDFI grant program nonprofit arts youth
California CDFI community development grant nonprofit 2026
CDFI Fund technical assistance grant nonprofit

categories.notes: Best covered by a paid database (Candid/Foundation Directory Online, Instrumentl) if you want comprehensiveness — those aggregate 990 filings to find foundations that have actually funded similar youth/arts orgs before. Web search is a reasonable free substitute for known/likely funders.
example_queries: California Community Foundation grants youth arts education
Ralph M Parsons Foundation grants Los Angeles youth
Annenberg Foundation grants Los Angeles youth arts

categories.category: LA City Council district discretionary funds
categories.notes: Each of the 15 LA City Council districts controls its own discretionary community/arts funding, separate from citywide programs. REQUIRES knowing which council district the program operates/serves in (fill this into org_profile.json). Also check LA County Board of Supervisors district offices if the program is unincorporated-county-adjacent.
example_queries: Los Angeles City Council District [NUMBER] discretionary grant nonprofit
Council District [NUMBER] youth arts funding application
LA County Board of Supervisors District [NUMBER] community grant arts youth
Neighborhood Council Los Angeles small grant arts education

categories.notes: From the org profile's target_funders list — check these first and on the tightest cadence.
example_queries: LA County Arts Commission grant cycle 2026 deadline
National Endowment for the Arts grant youth arts education deadline
Disney corporate giving grant application youth arts
